subject: design/implement-now-e2e-tasks
statement: once an authored test first passes in the worktree and **before any proposal is opened**, the executor re-runs that test under a **labelled perturbation battery** — varied ordering, the race detector where the stack has one, concurrent load, a perturbed clock and timezone, denied network, and a dirty ambient repository state. A verdict that moves under any perturbation, or across repeated identical runs, stops the task: it is marked failed naming the perturbation whose label identifies the non-hermetic dependency, its work is preserved on its branch, it is escalated, and **no proposal is opened**, so the check never becomes required and the self-heal loop — which exists only after a proposal — never runs (`prd:implement-now/FR-32`, `UB-17`).
